Name: A Winter Fruit---Yilisnow Fruit
Author: Yililusiours
Description:
A simple mod that adds a kind of crop growing in winter. It takes 15 days to mature,and the seeds appear on year 2, costing 500. You can sell them at the price of 1400. Recipes are also added using the fruit, you can buy 2 recipes at the Gus's saloon. A new machine is added , making the juice (called Extract)
[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
